name: Gray Beard

text.trigger: A player moves a survivor while Gray Beard is in the survivor deck and the colony has room.
text.vignette: On the edge of the colony a gaunt man with a long grey beard is feeding rounds into a rifle and he does not look pleased to see you. He does not say whether he is a threat or an offer, only that if you want his help it will be on his terms.

options.hand-over-a-card: Give him something and back away: a card chosen at random from your hand is removed from the game.
options.follow-his-rules: Take him on: Gray Beard leaves the survivor deck, joins your following as your leader, and this card goes under him. Once a round his attack costs no exposure roll. While he is yours, you may not put cards toward a crisis.

notes: src: Crossroad_cards_v1.1.xlsx.txt card #18; Not used in the co-op variant. The crisis ban ends when Gray Beard dies or changes hands (bound to the survivor).
